role.title: Role List
role.invalidCodes: These permission codes no longer exist and will be removed on save
role.invalidScopes: These data scope or field settings are no longer valid; the stricter value applies until you save

workbench.subtitle: Configure operations, data scopes and field visibility
workbench.packageHint: Check or uncheck a package to toggle its permissions. Other selections stay unchanged and required dependencies remain enabled. You can also adjust individual permissions below.
workbench.matchHint: Matching compares operations only. It does not represent a package binding or compare data scopes and field settings.
workbench.crossDependencies: Cross-resource permissions required by these operations
workbench.inactiveRestrictions: No operations granted yet. Existing restrictions are retained and take effect when operations are granted.
workbench.oneTimeHint: Packages are one-time templates. Saving records final permissions. Later server package changes do not automatically update this role.
workbench.loadFailed: Unable to load permissions; editing and saving are disabled
workbench.unsavedHint: Closing loses this draft. The role’s saved permissions remain unchanged.
workbench.invalidCodesHint: Remove invalid permission codes explicitly before saving
workbench.repairSummary: These invalid settings will be corrected on save
workbench.noRestrictionOptions: Only operation permissions apply to this resource. No additional data scope or field settings are available.
workbench.moduleBulkHint: Applies to all {{count}} permissions in this module, including hidden search results. Other modules, data scopes and field settings are retained.
workbench.menuLoadFailed: Menu structure could not be loaded. Editing by resource is available and your draft is retained.
workbench.sharedResource: {{name}} is shared. Configure it in its owning module
workbench.unknownMenuPermission: Some menus reference unknown permissions. Unmapped resources remain available in Other resources.
workbench.dependencyStillEffective: Some permissions remain effective because other actions require them. Inspect their sources to remove the corresponding actions.
workbench.dependencyPageAccess: Creating or editing announcements requires reading departments and selecting roles and users. Reading departments may also grant access to the department page.

role.deleteHint: Deleted roles cannot be restored. Continue?
role.noAccess: Your permission to perform this action was revoked.
